names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 17 martie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Πατρίκιος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 17 марта ст. ст., «Святитель Патрикий просветитель Ирландии, епископ, свт.», with the rank words left off. The link writes the by-name without a comma and the day's own line with one, «Патрикия, просветителя Ирландии»; the link's form is kept, as the link is where this corpus reads a Russian form.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «Sfântul Patrick, luminătorul Irlandei, s-a născut în jurul anului 381 d.Hr., într-un sat numit Bannaven Taberniae». days.pravoslavie.ru gives no year of birth.

death.note: The two calendars disagree by twenty-nine years and the interval holds both. doxologia.ro's life for the day: «Sfântul Patrick a trecut la cele veșnice pe 17 martie în jurul anului 480». days.pravoslavie.ru closes its line for 17 марта ст. ст. with «(451)» and carries no life for him at all, so there is nothing on that side to weigh against the Romanian reading. Nothing is chosen.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 марта ст. ст. — «Свт. Патрикия, просветителя Ирландии (451).»

attestations.note: The julian 17/3 is the same menologion day the Romanian and Greek keep him on. Neither the day page nor name page 14843 carries a life, and the name page lists this one day only. The line closes with 451 where doxologia gave about 480, and the two cannot both be right, so the death interval is now 451 to 480 and chooses neither. The day page prints no hymn under his name; the two hymns this folder already holds come from elsewhere.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 17 martie — «Sfântul Ierarh Patrick, Luminătorul Irlandei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Πατρίκιος»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page heads him «Αγιος Πατρικιος (; - 461)» and its years disagree with doxologia's, which the corpus's dates field carries: it puts his birth «περί το 380 μ.Χ.» at Glevum and his repose «το έτος 461 μ.Χ. (η κατ' άλλους το 493 μ.Χ.), στο Σάουτ της Ουαλίας», where doxologia gives about 381 and about 480. The disagreement is recorded here and the existing dates are left as they stand; no year has been changed on this reading.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Sfinte Ierarhe Patrick, făcătorule de minuni întocmai cu Apostolii, luminătorule al Irlandei, roagă-L pe Milostivul Dumnezeu să dăruiască sufletelor noastre iertare de greşale.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Patrick, Luminătorul Irlandei

english.text: O holy hierarch Patrick, wonderworker equal to the Apostles, enlightener of Ireland, entreat the merciful God to grant our souls forgiveness of offences.

hymns.text: Της Ιρλανδίας τον φωστήρα τον υπέρλαμπρον και των αποστόλων μιμητήν και ισοστάσιον συνελθόντες ανυμνήσωμεν χαρμοσύνως· παρρησίαν γαρ ευράμενος προς Κύριον ικετεύει λυτρωθήναι πάσης θλίψεως τους κραυγάζοντας· Χαίροις, Πάτερ Πατρίκιε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ήχος πλ. δ', Τη Υπερμάχω, on the page of Άγιος Πατρίκιος. It names him and Ireland, and an Οἶκος follows it on the page, so it is the kontakion of an akathist to him; saint.gr prints no apolytikion under his name, and the oikos is not taken here.

english.text: Come, let us gather and hymn with joy the most radiant luminary of Ireland, the imitator and equal of the apostles; for having found boldness before the Lord, he entreats that all who cry aloud be delivered from every affliction: rejoice, Father Patrick.
